modules.title: 对照登录页约定和实际变化

steps.label: 原定改动
steps.demo:
studio.example/login

检查范围
登录按钮颜色本次要改
页头和卡片保持原样
steps.caption: 先把本次约定说具体：登录按钮改成蓝色；页面其余部分不在本次交付里。

action.label: 查看 AI 改完的页面

steps.label: 混入额外改动
steps.demo:
studio.example/login
欢迎回来登录

使用邮箱登录你的工作区

按钮已变蓝；标题字号和卡片阴影也发生了变化

steps.caption: 按钮变化符合约定；标题变大、卡片出现阴影都不是本次要求，需要单独评估。

steps.label: 对照后复查
steps.demo:

modules.title: 怎样识别未评估的额外改动

items.title: 对照实际结果
items.text: 把本次约定与页面、改动记录逐项核对；改到别处不自动说明它错误，但不能未经评估就算进本次交付。

items.title: 合理变更另行评估
items.text: 确实需要的新需求可以成为正式范围；记录它并重新确认时间、交付内容和验收方式后再做。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 范围蔓延不等于所有范围调整。经讨论、记录和评估后正式加入的需求，是经过控制的范围变更；需要留意的是没有这个判断就混进当前工作里的新增内容。

lessonPractice.title: 你让 AI 把登录按钮改成蓝色。改动记录里还有页头标题和卡片阴影的变化。下一步怎么验收？

options.label: 对照原页面退回标题和阴影的变化，保留蓝色按钮后再验收
options.feedback: 对。原约定只涉及按钮颜色；把另外两处恢复后，页面仍保留本次目标改动。

options.label: 先把三处变化都留下，之后再决定这次实际交付哪些
options.feedback: 这样会让未讨论的标题和阴影也进入本次交付，验收范围仍然没有和原约定对齐。

options.label: 把按钮、标题和阴影的变化全部恢复到修改前
options.feedback: 这会连约定好的蓝色按钮也一起撤销；只需处理未约定的两处变化。

en.title: You ask AI to change a button color, and it also changes the card shadow and the page title size. What should happen?

options.label: Compare with the original page, undo the title and shadow edits, then accept the blue button
options.feedback: Correct. The request covered only the button color; restore the other two changes and keep the requested result.

options.label: Keep all three changes for now, then decide later which ones to deliver
options.feedback: That leaves the unreviewed title and shadow edits inside this delivery, so it still does not match the agreed scope.

options.label: Restore the button, title, and shadow to their original appearance
options.feedback: That also removes the requested blue button. Only the two unrequested changes need review.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请只把登录按钮改成蓝色。完成后对照页面和改动记录，确认页头和卡片没有被顺手改动；如果确实需要调整其他地方，先说明原因。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Change only the login button to blue. Afterward, compare the page and change list to confirm the header and cards were not changed along the way. If another area really needs an update, explain why first.

references.title: 范围蔓延不一定是坏事
references.title_en: Scope creep ... not necessarily a bad thing

learning.assumes: You have seen a project grow beyond plan, or had AI make changes you did not ask for.
learning.outcome: You can compare the agreed work with the actual page, keep the requested change, and identify what should be reverted or evaluated separately.

modules.title: Compare the login-page request with the actual changes

steps.label: Agreed change
steps.demo:
studio.example/login
Welcome backLog in
Agreed: change only the login button to blue
Check the scope
Login button colorChange this time
Header and cardKeep as they are
steps.caption: Make the agreement concrete first: turn the login button blue and leave the rest of the page as it is.

action.label: View the page after AI's edit

steps.label: Extra changes appear
steps.demo:
studio.example/login
Welcome backLog in

Use email to sign in to your workspace

The button is blue; the title size and card shadow also changed
Change record
Login button colorChanged
Header title / card shadowExtra changes
steps.caption: The button matches the request. The larger title and new card shadow were not requested and need separate evaluation.

steps.label: Compare again
steps.demo:
studio.example/login
Welcome backLog in
Only the agreed button change remains
Change record
Login button colorBlue · kept
Header title / card shadowRestored
steps.caption: The page now contains only the agreed button change. A new title or shadow request can be recorded and evaluated separately.

items.title: Compare the actual result
items.text: Compare the agreement with the page and change record. An edit elsewhere is not automatically wrong, but it should not silently enter this delivery.

items.title: Evaluate real changes separately
items.text: A needed request can join the scope after it is recorded and evaluated with a new delivery and acceptance plan.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Scope creep is not every scope adjustment. A discussed, recorded, and evaluated request is a controlled change; the concern is new work slipping into the current plan without that decision.

distinctions.label: Requirement change
distinctions.text: A requirement change formally adjusts scope after evaluation and syncs everyone; scope creep adds requirements without evaluation.

distinctions.label: Backlog
distinctions.text: Backlog items are queued and not yet decided; scope creep is the part already being done that exceeds the agreed scope.
